problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f:E→ℝ. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ; R,Δ>0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The jointly measurable oracle is unbiased, E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x), with E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ². Only gradient samples are supplied. All setup parameters, including L0,L1,R,Δ,σ,ε,δ,x0, are public; f and the sampling laws are hidden. Cost counts every gradient sample within a fixed budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID, IsLightTailGradient, spec.Public, spec.publicInput and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticSmoothAndConvex.lean: StochasticGradient.IsStochasticGradient; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and ‖D(∇f)(x)‖≤L0+L1‖∇f(x)‖ for every x, with L0>0 and L1≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform additive noise bound E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ² for every x, with σ≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Norm light-tail condition E exp(‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²/σ²)≤e at every x, with integrability explicitly required. Seeds are measurable, mutually independent, and identically distributed. E is a real complete inner-product space with Borel measurable structure and second-countable topology; no finite-dimensional restriction is imposed.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X satisfying f(X)−f(x⋆)≤ε with the specified probability, for some global minimizer x⋆; ε>0. No particular iterate or averaging rule is required.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(X)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤δ, where 0<δ<1. Probability includes both algorithm randomization and oracle seeds; the oracle-call budget is fixed for every seed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This convex stochastic optimization formulation combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness with IID norm-light-tailed additive noise and a high-probability objective-gap requirement in a potentially infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.
